title: Zephyr Helicopters

services.name: Zephyr Helicopters
services.desc: From quick Oceanside coastal hops to extended flights over the Ocotillo Wells desert, every Zephyr tour delivers breathtaking views and memories that last a lifetime. Select the experience that fits your adventure. Each one is priced per person with upgrades available (like doors-off, champagne or local craft beers). Use our simple booking tool or give us a call. We’ll confirm your time, send confirmation details, and answer any questions. Every seat is a window seat. You’ll wear a noise cancelling headset and hear live commentary from your knowledgeable pilot as you fly by
